title: Definitions
text: Insured person: the person named on the policy schedule. Claim: a request for reimbursement or payment under this policy. Claims handler: the insurer's employee authorised to decide claims. Medical adviser: the physician who advises the insurer on medical questions under professional secrecy.

title: Own risk
text: The insured pays the first EUR 385 of covered medical costs in each calendar year (own risk). GP consultations, maternity care and costs for children under 18 do not count toward the own risk.

title: Physiotherapy
text: Physiotherapy is covered up to 9 sessions per calendar year under the supplementary package, on referral by a GP or specialist. Sessions after surgery on the knee, hip or spine are covered without referral for the first 12 weeks after the operation.

title: Hospital care
text: Hospital admission, surgery and emergency care are covered in full after the own risk, at contracted hospitals. At non-contracted hospitals reimbursement is limited to 75 percent of the market rate, except in an emergency.

title: Mental health care
text: Treatment by a registered psychologist or psychiatrist is covered after the own risk on referral by a GP, for diagnosed conditions. Coaching and preventive sessions are not covered.

title: Medical aids
text: Hearing aids are covered at 75 percent of the purchase price up to EUR 1,500 per aid every five years, on prescription by an ENT specialist or audiologist. Insulin pens and glucose test strips are covered in full on prescription.

title: Maternity care
text: Antenatal checks, two routine ultrasounds (around 12 and 20 weeks) and delivery care by a midwife are covered in full and do not count toward the own risk.

title: Travel: medical costs abroad
text: Emergency medical costs abroad, including hospital admission, are covered up to the cost of the same care at home, and in full inside the EU with a valid EHIC. The insured must notify the emergency line within 48 hours of an admission.

title: Travel: luggage
text: Lost, stolen or damaged luggage is covered up to EUR 1,500 per trip, with a limit of EUR 500 per item. Theft must be reported to the police within 24 hours; loss by an airline requires the airline's property irregularity report. Receipts or proof of value are required.

title: Claim documents
text: A claim must include the claim form, an itemised invoice, and for medical costs the referral or prescription where this policy requires one. The insurer may request further documents; medical documents are requested by and sent to the medical adviser only.

title: Claim deadlines
text: Claims must be submitted within 12 months of the treatment or incident. The insurer decides within 30 days of receiving a complete claim and informs the insured of the reasons for any reduction or rejection.

title: Exclusions
text: Not covered: cosmetic treatment without medical necessity, costs caused by intent or by driving under the influence, and care received before the policy start date for a condition known to the insured.

title: How claims are decided
text: Every decision to pay, reduce or reject a claim is taken by a claims handler. Automated tools may check completeness, extract amounts and prepare a recommendation; they do not decide. The insured may ask for the reasons and contest a decision.

title: Health data in claims
text: Health data in a claim is processed only as far as needed to assess that claim, only by staff bound to secrecy, and medical judgement is given by the medical adviser. Health data from one policy is not used for another policy without explicit consent.
